VV.FuckUp.title: Fuck Up Table
VV.FuckUp.converted: (You turned this result into a successful cast, so it does not hurt you.)
VV.StatusDesc.downed: LIFE is 0 and you cannot act. After 3 turns Downed without being healed or stabilised you die (or turn Warlock). An Adjacent ally can stabilise you with a Tactical Action, or heal you with magic or a potion.
VV.StatusDesc.knocked: Brawl only: your LIFE hit 0 but you are not Downed. You regain full LIFE after a 15 minute rest. Roll on the Konk table; you cannot be Knocked Out twice in 24 hours.
VV.StatusDesc.prone: You've fallen over. You can't cast spells or use martial skills until you get up. Cure: use a Tactical Action to stand up.
VV.StatusDesc.poisoned: Take 1 damage whenever you use a Combat or Tactical Action. Cure: drink an antidote, or get Drunk, using 1 Tactical Action.
VV.StatusDesc.drunk: All DCs are +3 (spells, martial skills, lockpicking...). Sex takes twice as long and its Quality is never above Fine. Poison is cured. Cure: wait 2d4 hours, or eat rations equal to your Moxie (minimum 1).
VV.StatusDesc.filthy: All Disposition checks are -5. If you are also Poisoned, take 1 extra damage after every action. Stealth checks are +10 harder (sticky squelching). Cure: use 1 day's water, or find a river or Bathhouse.
VV.StatusDesc.burning: Take d6 damage on your turn, 2d6 on the next, 3d6 on the third, and so on until the fire is out. Cure: use 1 day's water for every d6 of burning damage you are taking this turn.
VV.StatusDesc.stun: You've taken a bonk to the noggin. Miss your next turn.
VV.StatusDesc.terrified: You are practically paralysed with fear. You lose one Tactical Action and all your spells, skills and attacks have half their intended effect. Cure: get Drunk, or have an ally give you an encouraging hug or pat (1 Tactical Action).
VV.StatusDesc.charmed: The GM takes control of your character until you resist the spell. Roll to resist first on your turn, before the GM uses your actions. Cure: resist with DC + Moxie (usually 10 to 16).
VV.StatusDesc.horny: You are inconceivably aroused. Temporarily lose 1 Moxie or 1 Smarts every 12 hours, whichever is higher, down to a maximum of -3. Cure: have sex, or take 30 minutes to cure yourself.
VV.StatusDesc.blinded: All you see is light, or darkness. Roll a successful DC10 before each Combat or Tactical Action to perform it correctly, otherwise you fall Prone. Cure: wait d4 turns until it wears off.
VV.StatusDesc.restrain: Ropes, chains, tentacles or something's mouth. You cannot do anything except try to escape. Cure: roll DC + Moxie to free yourself (usually 7 to 15), or have an ally cut you free with a Combat Action.
VV.StatusDesc.berserk: You've lost your marbles. You can only use Basic Attacks, but they deal double damage. Cure: resist your bloodlust with DC + Moxie (usually 7 to 12), or get Drunk, Stunned or Terrified.
VV.StatusDesc.dehydrated: After 24 hours without water you take 2d6 damage; after 48 hours 4d6; after 72 hours 6d6, and so on. Cure: drink 1 day's water for every d6 of dehydration damage you are taking today.
VV.StatusDesc.starving: After 24 hours without food you temporarily lose 1 Moxie; after 48 hours another 1, up to a maximum of -6 Moxie. Cure: eat food or rations equal to the Moxie you lost.
VV.StatusDesc.exhausted: After 24 hours without sleep you temporarily lose 1 Smarts and 1 Brawn; after 48 hours another 1 each; after 72 hours you pass out for 24 hours wherever you are. Cure: sleep for 12 hours.
